description: Record a choice the human may want a say in, with the default you are going with, then keep working on that default. Returns right away; the answer comes back on a later start_task, finish_task or recommend_task. Set blocking only for hard-to-undo choices (it blocks the affected tasks until answered, so move to other work). FYI notes for the reviewer belong in progress questions instead.

blocking.description: Block the affected tasks until answered. Rare; needs taskIds.

costly.description: True if the default would be costly to reverse later

default.description: What you are doing until it is answered

question.description: The question, answerable in a sentence

taskIds.description: Tasks whose direction depends on the answer (max 20)

workspaceId.description: Optional when this repo is bound to a workspace (bind_workspace).

name: ask_decision
